name: RIG-I/MDA5 antiviral signaling with interferon-alpha effector response
rationale: All members concern cytosolic nucleic-acid sensing (RIG-I/MDA5, DNA sensing) driving IRF3/type I IFN antiviral responses; unlike the RLR confusables it adds downstream interferon-alpha responses and effectors (OAS, IP-10, chemokine induction).

name: Keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation control in wound re-epithelialization
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and adhesion; the epidermal wound-spreading, wound-healing epithelial proliferation and delamination members separate it from hair follicle/melanocyte, cornification and IL-20 wound-migration confusables.

name: Axon sprouting, regeneration and Sema3A-mediated growth repulsion
rationale: Members control axon/neurite growth, collateral sprouting and regeneration with Sema3A/RHOA and ceramide growth-inhibitory signaling, lacking the myelination/glial content of C1-C2 and the developmental innervation focus of C3-C4.

name: Calcitonin-family and glucagon-type peptide receptor cAMP signaling
rationale: Members are peptide-hormone GPCRs (glucagon-type, calcitonin/amylin/CGRP, relaxin, somatostatin) coupled to adenylate cyclase/cAMP; the calcitonin-family receptors distinguish it from free fatty acid, feeding and insulin-secretion confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ growth control and replicative senescence
rationale: Members center on Hippo/YAP-TAZ signaling, cell-density sensing and growth arrest; the senescence, lifespan, X-ray response and growth-rate members are what all confusables lack.

name: Intra-Golgi retrograde vesicle traffic
rationale: All three members describe vesicle transport and recycling between Golgi cisternae, distinct from Golgi organization, endosome-to-Golgi and TGN sorting confusables.

name: RUNX1 transcriptional programs and megakaryocyte-erythroid differentiation
rationale: Members are RUNX1-driven transcriptional regulation across targets plus megakaryocyte/platelet and erythroid differentiation; the broad RUNX1 target set and megakaryocyte arm separate it from granulocytic and progenitor confusables.

qualifier: docking, priming and transmitter release cycles
name: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming and neurotransmitter release cycle
rationale: Members cover SNARE assembly, vesicle docking/priming and calcium-dependent release for multiple transmitters, unlike confusables centered on presynaptic plasticity or vesicle endocytosis/recycling.

name: Canonical and non-canonical NF-kappaB activation via IKK complex
rationale: Members describe IKK/TAK1-mediated canonical and NIK-dependent non-canonical NF-kappaB activation from TLR, TNFR1, CD40 and antigen receptors with ubiquitin control; confusables instead carry NOD, JNK/p38 and inflammasome signaling.

name: Chemokine receptor-driven dendritic cell and T cell chemotaxis
rationale: Members are chemokine/receptor signaling (CXCR4, CCR7) guiding leukocyte migration, with dendritic cell and T/NK chemotaxis distinguishing it from B-cell homing, monocyte, mast-cell and integrin confusables.

qualifier: FLT3, ALK and FGFR; inhibitor resistance
name: FLT3, ALK and FGFR oncogenic mutants and inhibitor resistance
rationale: All members are oncogenic RTK mutants or fusions and their kinase-inhibitor resistance; FLT3, ALK and FGFR content separates it from KIT/PDGFR resistance and normal FLT3/cytokine signaling confusables.

name: Cardiac conduction system development and pacemaker coupling
rationale: Members concern formation of SA node, AV node and His-Purkinje tissue plus HCN and gap-junction coupling, whereas confusables cover action-potential phases and ion-channel electrophysiology.

name: Presynaptic catecholamine reuptake by dopamine and norepinephrine transporters
rationale: Members describe dopamine/norepinephrine uptake and its SLC6A3/SLC6A2 transporter disorders, distinct from biosynthesis, vesicular loading and catabolism confusables.

name: Dystroglycan O-mannosylation and dystroglycanopathy muscular dystrophies
rationale: All members are DAG1 O-mannosyl glycan synthesis or its enzyme defects causing dystroglycanopathies, unlike GAG, keratan sulfate, GDP-mannose and muscle confusables.

name: Plasma membrane-endosome cycling and constitutive secretory traffic
rationale: Members cover endocytosis, endocytic/receptor recycling and endosome organization; constitutive secretion and Golgi-membrane protein localization distinguish it from retrograde, Rab/ARF and early-to-late endosome confusables.

name: Poly(ADP-ribose) signaling and chromatin remodeling at DNA breaks
rationale: Members concern ADP-ribosylation/de-ADP-ribosylation, repair-dependent chromatin remodeling and protein recruitment at double-strand breaks, unlike NHEJ execution, topology and crosslink-repair confusables.

name: RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK cascade, oncogenic mutants and negative feedback
rationale: Members describe RAS/RAF/MAP2K/ERK activation, their oncogenic variants and ERK dephosphorylation feedback, distinct from IRS, ERK5/AP-1/IL-6 and Rap1-integrin confusables.

name: cAMP-PKA second-messenger signaling via stimulatory adenylate cyclase
rationale: Members cover adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis/degradation, PKA, CREB and DARPP-32 events, whereas confusables carry PLC/IP3 or alpha-2 adrenergic adenylate cyclase inhibition.

name: Centrosome cohesion, positioning and microtubule nucleation-anchoring
rationale: Members concern centrosome localization, centriole cohesion and MTOC microtubule nucleation/anchoring, lacking the mitotic centrosome, cilia and spindle-orientation content of confusables.

core: Epithelial amino acid and urate transport
name: Renal epithelial amino acid and urate transporters and aminoacidurias
rationale: Members are plasma-membrane SLC transport of amino acids, cystine and urate and their aminoaciduria/hypouricemia defects, distinct from organic ion and peptide transporter confusables.

name: Toll-like receptor signaling regulation and inflammatory cytokine induction
rationale: Members regulate TLR (MyD88, TLR3/4) and CD40 signaling and IL-6/IL-8/TNF production, unlike IL-1/IL-37 regulation and TRIF/TAK1 mechanistic confusables.

name: Eph-ephrin and DCC growth cone guidance signaling
rationale: Members are ephrin receptor signaling, growth cone collapse, RAC1 activation and DCC attraction, distinguishing it from netrin repulsion, Robo-Slit and filopodium confusables.

name: Neutrophil granulopoiesis driven by G-CSF and GM-CSF signaling
rationale: Members cover granulopoiesis transcription, neutrophil differentiation and G-CSF/GM-CSF responses, unlike broader myeloid progenitor, eosinophil/mast and macrophage confusables.

name: Pharyngeal endoderm-derived gland development
rationale: Thymus, parathyroid and thyroid all develop from pharyngeal endoderm, distinct from craniofacial, outflow tract, otic and mesoderm confusables.

core: Cancer-associated TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants
name: Cancer TGF-beta receptor and SMAD mutants and betaglycan regulation
rationale: Members are oncogenic TGFBR1/2 and SMAD2/3/4 mutants plus TGFBR3 (betaglycan) regulation, distinct from activin, RUNX3/Hippo and normal TGF-beta pathway confusables.
